checks.detail: max residual outside m = 1.17e-15 -- confirms [h,m] subset m (reductive decomposition), required for R^c's closed-form to apply.

checks.name: t2_r_tensor_is_genuinely_nonzero_somewhere
checks.detail: max |R^c component| = 0.430866 -- confirms this is not a trivially-vanishing construction before checking the 3bar-restriction specifically (a nonzero object overall, that may still vanish on one summand).

checks.name: t3_va_matrices_antisymmetric
checks.detail: max |V_a + V_a^T| = 4.44e-16 (expected ~0 for an orthonormal m-basis)

checks.name: t3_m_is_casimir_irreducible_single_eigenvalue
checks.detail: C2|_m eigenvalues = [-1.333333 -1.333333 -1.333333 -1.333333 -1.333333 -1.333333], spread = 3.11e-15 -- m must be a single real irreducible su(3)-module (3(+)3bar complexified), hence Casimir-scalar, per Schur's Lemma applied to the REAL representation.

checks.name: t3_lambda2m_has_exactly_3_distinct_casimir_eigenvalues
checks.detail: got 3 distinct eigenvalues: [-3.      -1.33333  0.     ], expected 3 (singlet=0, fundamental x6, adjoint x8) matching Lambda^2(3(+)3bar) = 3bar(+)1(+)8(+)3

checks.name: t3_fundamental_block_eigenvalue_matches_m_own_casimir
checks.detail: Lambda^2m fundamental-block eigenvalue = -1.33333, m's own C2 = -1.333333

checks.name: t4_R_c_vanishes_on_fundamental_3plus3bar_block
checks.detail: max|R^c|_fund| / max|R^c| = 1.735e-15 -- if < 1e-4, confirms ZERO-ON-3BAR-SUMMAND (the 3bar summand is a subspace of this 6-dim fundamental block, so a zero restriction here implies zero specifically on 3bar, and on 3, by linear algebra alone -- restriction of a zero map to any subspace is zero).

checks.name: t4_su3_c_is_casimir_irreducible_confirms_adjoint_8
checks.detail: C2|_su3(adjoint action) eigenvalues spread = 4.44e-15 -- confirms su(3)_C is a single irreducible 8-dim module under its own adjoint action (standard for a simple Lie algebra), non-isomorphic to the 3-dim 3bar by dimension count alone -- Schur's Lemma therefore forces Hom_su3(3bar,8)=0 independent of the specific curvature values found above.
